Free access to Poncho Spanish

Hi everyone,

I'm delighted to give you free access to all the courses and e-books on Poncho Spanish. Here's how to get started:

1. Go to ponchospanish.com/ondemand and choose the course or e-book you'd like.
2. Click "Create a free account" (or sign in if you already have one).
3. Under "or use a code", type PONCHOCOMMUNITY2027 and click "Apply access code".

That's it! To unlock another course or e-book, simply open it and enter the same code again.

Happy learning!
Anto
